title: Tagine with Meat
description: A traditional Moroccan dish, slow-cooked in a clay pot with aromatic spices and tender meat. Serve over couscous for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: meat
ingredients.amount: 1 pound beef or lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.amount: 1 whole, cleaned, and cut in half

ingredients.name: rest
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, chopped mixed vegetables (such as carrots, potatoes, and zucchini)

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of the tagine over medium heat.
Add the meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped vegetables, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the honey and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender.
Serve over couscous, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
